headline: On October 10, 1975: Papua New Guinea joins the United Nations
captionCards: PNG covers 462,840 km2 with hundreds of islands
Shares borders with Indonesia, Australia, and Solomon Islands
instagramCaption:
Papua New Guinea officially joined the United Nations in 1975. This island nation in Oceania comprises the eastern half of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia. It shares a land border with Indonesia to the west and maritime borders with Australia and the Solomon Islands. Its capital is Port Moresby. The country covers 462,840 km2 including hundreds of islands. Why does this independence matter today? What do you know about Melanesian history?
